text:
sarah: Heads-up — competitive signal: NovaAI launched per-request routing tags + cost tiers. We need to decide if we push parity or double-down on cost-aware differentiation. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
ajay: saw the thread. they ship a "tiered routing" that pins model variants by cost. customers asked for similar. who's driving enterprise parity ask?
maya: field reports: 3 enterprise customers asked for "route by SLA" last quarter. one is waiting on fallback guarantees. They also want local model fallback for privacy.
lin: product tradeoffs: parity is straightforward but could cannibalize Redwood Optimize upsell. alternative: ship a modeled "cost routing DSL" that supports policy + defaults. faster win?
sarah: propose: M0 - parity: per-request "route_policy" param + UI. M1 - differentiation: cost-aware policy suggestions + auto-quantization. M2 - routing optimizer service. timeline?
ajay: implementation notes: runtime supports policy routing but needs auth mapping + rate-limits. rough estimate: parity API + simple UI -> 3 sprints (eng: runtime + console). M1 features need optimizer infra.
maya: customers prefer opt-in parity first. recommend beta with one customer (Acme) to validate before committing infra.
lin: can we do a lightweight shim: client-side SDK adds route hints and we map to existing fallback rules? then console shows where it mapped. non-invasive.
sarah: agree. sketch of API:
```
POST /v1/generate
{ "model": "redwood/fast-v1", "route_policy": {"primary": "fast-v1", "fallback": "compact-v1", "cost_target": "<10ms/ token"}}
```
We should include policy validation and a warning if cost_target incompatible.
product-bot: @sarah created feature ticket RF-4123 and linked mockups https://redwood.internal/pm/RF-4123
ajay: blockers: metrics for cost per token per model variant + rollout flags. Need tracking in console for canary.
maya: launch criteria proposal: 1) parity API + SDK + 1 pilot customer, 2) console shows policy mapping and token cost delta, 3) fallback verified under load.
sarah: + add rollback playbook and default fallback to "dedicated" for enterprise.
lin: timeline: aim for alpha by end of next sprint. I'll scope tech spike to 5 days.
ajay: ok assigning RF-4123 to eng-routing, spike ticket RF-4123-spike. will update by EOD.
maya: thx. i'll line up pilot and legal for data flow sign-off.
sarah: moving to decision: exec asks for parity first with optional opt-in optimizer. I'll draft PRD and post in #product-docs. :white_check_mark:
